Perplexity is explicitly used throughout the paper as the primary automatic evaluation metric for language model outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses exclusively on language modeling evaluation using perplexity. The metadata extraction was accurate and complete. The paper introduces Shortformer - a modified transformer architecture using position-infused attention and staged training for more efficient language modeling. All evaluation is automatic (perplexity) with no human or LLM-as-judge assessment.
